# What quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC) does

:::{.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

For $\vx_1,, \vx_2 \ldots \IIDsim \Unif[0,1]^d$
\begin{multline*}
\sqrt{\Ex\left[ \left( \int_{[0,1]^d} f(\vx) \, \dif \vx - \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n f(\vx_i) \right)^2 \right]} \\
= \frac{\std(f)}{\alert{\sqrt{n}}}
\end{multline*}

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

For carefully chosen $\vx_1, \vx_2, \ldots \LDsim \Unif[0,1]^d$
$$
\left \lvert \int_{[0,1]^d} f(\vx) \, \dif \vx - \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n f(\vx_i) \right \rvert  = \underbrace{D(\{\vx_i\}_{i=1}^n)}_{\Order(\alert{n^{-1+\delta}})} \cdot V(f)
$$
:::

:::
